metadata.name: 영암 코리아 인터내셔널 서킷
metadata.method: 2013 spectator footage, registered FIA2013 runoff/gravel envelopes, operator aerial and OSM physical features; source-backed display approximations.
metadata.approximation: Manual plan-view placement; boundaries, off-road elevation and individual tree positions/heights are not surveyed.
metadata.localAxes: x east, y south, metres in TrackMath built-track coordinates.
limitations: Reference footage depicts the2013KoreanGP and was uploaded2022-01-05. It is a fixed western T9–T10 spectator view with pans, not a complete lap. Exact camera seat is unconfirmed.

FIA2013 map runoff polygons are registered to the existing GP centreline with1.30m RMS fit. This fit error is not a survey accuracy claim for runoff edges; widths, barrier heights and paint placement remain estimates.

Stripe direction,7m pitch/4.5m painted width/2.5m gap and phase are visual approximations, approximately30percent dimensional uncertainty. T11 is a separate aerial-confirmed striped area, not the video camera location.
Only cited curb intervals are reconstructed; unreviewed edges use neutral white lines rather than a full perimeter curb inference. Sector colors on the FIA map are not interpreted as curbs.

Open dry-grass appearance uses a default terrain color; unfilled white map regions are not asserted to be surveyed grass. Random infield forest clusters are disabled. One explicitly mapped gravel trap is distinguished from paved runoffs.
GP and permanent share physical source geometry reprojected through WGS84; their canonical distances and active pit compounds differ. Existing road/elevation/physics and timing origin are unchanged.
Historical footprints/2013 appearance are combined with operator images of unknown capture date. Source media is local reference only and is not redistributed.

T11 outer paved striped area meets short red-white edge segments in the operator aerial; approximate interval.
